title: Pompeii: The City Buried in a Day #Shorts
description:
A short historical overview of the AD 79 eruption that buried Pompeii. This video is an educational summary; dates and details should be checked against reliable historical sources.

#DarkHistory #HistoryShorts #Pompeii
scenes:
POMPEII
A CITY FROZEN IN TIME
Nearly 2,000 years ago, Pompeii was a busy Roman city near Mount Vesuvius.
In AD 79, the volcano erupted with little warning for many residents.
Ash and pumice fell over the city, burying streets, homes, and public buildings.
Pyroclastic flows later swept through the area, making escape deadly for many.
The buried city preserved a haunting snapshot of everyday Roman life.
